event.description: Use a rank-8 factorized learned position table
event.proposal: family: position representation; retained incumbent is 4288 parameters at 99.9100%, a +0.91 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: attempt-0005, the repaired structured-position candidate at 4784 parameters and 8.85%; prior position attempts: 3 (attempts 0003, 0004, 0005, including one implementation repair). Attempt-0003 fixed sinusoidal positions scored 0.01%, so this proposal retains learned position rows instead of using a deterministic basis. Hypothesis: a rank-8 learned table plus d16 projection retains position-specific degrees of freedom while sharing only the feature basis, reducing position parameters from 560 to 35*8 + 8*16 = 408 and total parameters to 4136. This is more informative than repeating segment sharing because each of the 35 positions remains independently addressable. Keep reversed operands, ff20, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 4288 parameters.
